remarks:
Attention investors and DIY enthusiasts! Bring your vision and toolbox to 151 Johnson St, Buffalo, NY 14211. This 3-bedroom, 1-bathroom home offers a fantastic opportunity to build sweat equity or add to your rental portfolio. The exterior features classic light-colored vinyl siding and a chain-link fenced yard. Inside, the main living level features an arched entryway connecting the living and dining areas, creating a cozy flow. The kitchen comes equipped with white shaker-style cabinets and granite countertops, ready for your finishing touches.
The home includes a main-level laundry/utility room and a bedroom. Upstairs, you will find two additional bedrooms under the charming angles of the roofline. Recent updates include a new furnace installed in October 2023, providing a solid mechanical starting point. While the property requires significant cosmetic updates—including flooring, drywall repair, and general modernization—it is a blank canvas awaiting a complete transformation. Don't miss this chance to restore and revitalize this diamond in the rough. Property is sold AS-IS. Cash or renovation loans only.
